The '''2009–10 Scottish Premier League''' season was the twelfth season of the [[Scottish Premier League]]. [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] were the defending champions and they retained the championship with three games to spare by winning 1–0 against [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] at [[Easter Road]] on 25 April.<ref name = "rangers retain">{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/scot_prem/8638892.stm|title=Hibernian 0 – 1 Rangers|date=25 April 2010|work=BBC Sport |publisher=BBC| first=Andy |last=Campbell |access-date=26 April 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100427005438/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/scot_prem/8638892.stm| archive-date= 27 April 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> The competition began on 15 August 2009 and ended on 9 May 2010.

==Events==
{{main|2009–10 in Scottish football#Notable events}}

* 21 April – [[Inverness Caledonian Thistle F.C.|Inverness Caledonian Thistle]] won promotion to the [[Scottish Premier League]] as [[Scottish First Division|First Division]] champions following a 1–0 defeat for their nearest challengers [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] against [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/scot_div_1/8633826.stm |work=BBC Sport|title=Raith Rovers 1–0 Dundee |date=21 April 2010 |access-date=21 April 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100424235738/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/scot_div_1/8633826.stm| archive-date= 24 April 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref>
* 25 April – [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] clinch the championship by winning 1–0 against [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] at [[Easter Road]].<ref name = "rangers retain"/>
* 5 May – The [[Motherwell v Hibernian (5 May 2010)|6–6 draw]] between [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]] and [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] at [[Fir Park]] breaks the SPL record for the most goals scored in a single SPL match.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/scot_prem/8658858.stm |work=BBC Sport|title=Motherwell 6–6 Hibernian |date=5 May 2010 |access-date=5 May 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100507091100/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/scot_prem/8658858.stm| archive-date= 7 May 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://twitter.com/optajoe/status/13446046162 |publisher=Opta Sports / Twitter |title=12 – The 6–6 draw between Motherwell and Hibs tonight, breaks the SPL record for the most goals in a single SPL match. Entertainment. |date=5 May 2010 |access-date=5 May 2010}}</ref>
*8 May – [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] were relegated after goalless draw against [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]] at [[Rugby Park]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/scot_prem/8666163.stm|work=BBC Sport|title= Kilmarnock 0-0 Falkirk|date=8 May 2010|access-date=8 May 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100511160425/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/scot_prem/8666163.stm| archive-date= 11 May 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref>
